season.evidence: Stored Jul-Oct holds. Logged successful ascents run Jun-Oct (Jul 25, Aug 39, Sep 38, Oct 7). Web search of Mountaineers East Face/East Ridge reports and SummitPost: early July still has steep hard snow on the PCT past the Katwalk and at the ridge base; Aug-Sep easy; late Sep/Oct snow possible near the Katwalk. No source names a single best month.

track.why: Logged route is 'East Ridge' (Oct 5 2020); report says he scrambled the exposed 4th-class east ridge; line leaves the PCT near Joe Lake/Huckleberry Flats, climbs the east side and ends on the summit (about 20 m from our pin). Start is 74 m from our PCT North trailhead pin. Ascent-only recording (return not in file). Early Oct is the last month of the stored season.

facts.text: Ice axe and crampons (early July snow on the PCT beyond the Katwalk and at the ridge base)
Early July: PCT beyond the Katwalk is mostly snow-covered, with steep hard snow and a runout below the trail
Rock on the ridge and the final summit moves is crumbly through Aug-Oct; test every hold before weighting it
Late Aug-Sep: many parties scramble the lower ridge unroped and only rope up for the notch and the last crack.
From the Joe Lake stretch of the PCT, the east slope's heather and blueberry bench leads to the 6,000 ft shoulder and the crest; there is no need to cut onto the loose south-face gully (August).
Bring bug repellent in early July; mosquitoes and flies are heavy around Ridge Lake and Gravel Lake camps.

notes: No report anywhere names West Face, South Face, North Route, North Spur or Southwest Slope; those routes likely have no recorded ascents on Peakbagger. The West Face row carries the existing 370-point track. Reports logged as 'East Face' (2017, 2022, 2024) describe the same ridge as 'East Ridge'; consider treating them as one line when matching later. North Route, North Spur and Southwest Slope are empty rows (no text, pins or grade) and may be placeholders.
